_meta.purpose: Seed eval set for the Phase-2 retrieval/decomposition agent (HANDOFF.md section 8, module E-seed). DATA ONLY - there is no run_eval.py yet (that is Phase-2 build, gated on the retriever existing). Each case pins a natural-language intent to the expected MotionKB retrieval result, so the retriever can be scored against it once built.
_meta.corpus: agent/kb - the 8 accepted v2 actions (see kb_manifest.json)
_meta.channels: the v2 9-channel vocabulary (engine_mask_map.json): root, torso, head, left_arm, right_arm, left_leg, right_leg, left_hand, right_hand

expected_type.full_match: one whole clip satisfies the intent -> action_id
expected_type.decompose: no single clip matches; the intent is composed per-channel from >1 action (parts[]) over a base, leaving free_channels
expected_type.no_match: the intent is outside the corpus (a SCENARIO section 6 coverage gap); nearest names the closest action

cases.query: the nurse stands idle and at ease beside the bed
the nurse walks across the room toward the patient
the nurse sits at the computer and types up her charting notes
the nurse hands the patient the oral medication to take
the nurse performs chest compressions on the patient
the nurse reaches out and grabs the aspirin bottle, then lifts it
the nurse leans in and feels the patient's wrist for a pulse
the nurse seals the mask on the patient's face and squeezes the bag to ventilate
the nurse walks to the bedside while carrying the medicine bottle in her right hand

parts.note: the carry corresponds to the source's 'Hold Pills' upper-body overlay (right arm + fingers); approximated from grab_bottle's grasp pose. A dedicated 'carry' clip is a known KB gap.

cases.query: the nurse gives the patient the pills while turning her head to glance at the monitor

expected.note: head is retargeted to a gaze-at-monitor look (aim-IK to a scene target); no head-only clip exists, so the head channel is solved by IK, not retrieval - exercises the FK-retrieval vs IK-goal split.

cases.query: the nurse presses a button on the cardiac monitor

expected.note: button-push (Button Pushing.anim) is a SCENARIO section 6 coverage gap, not in the 8-action KB.

cases.query: the nurse picks up the phone and calls the cath lab

expected.note: call (Call.anim) is a SCENARIO section 6 coverage gap, not in the 8-action KB.
